fen.description: Canonical FEN: ep field normalized to '-' unless a legal en-passant capture exists; clocks preserved

positionKey.description: placement stm castling ep(only-if-legal) halfmoveBucket(0-49/50-79/80-99/100+); fullmove excluded

file.description: human-readable basename; NOT unique across inputs that share a basename

id.description: stable unique source id: path relative to --source-root ('/'-normalized) or '<parentDir>/<basename>'; never an absolute path or username

gameIndex.description: 0-based index of the game within its source file

gameKey.description: content-derived game identity (headers + full mainline hash); AUTHORITATIVE for split-leakage detection

result.description: PGN game result of the source game
